summary: Iteratively debugged and fixed the ask-user test file (replacing beforeAll with beforeEach, switching a proxy-aware toBe to an id comparison, and scoping the Blue text query via getAllByText+closest), corrected a relative import depth issue in pi-extensions/ask-user/src/web/AskUserToolResult.svelte to reach packages/protocol/src/index, and cast test fixture status to 'complete' as const to satisfy the ToolCallView type. Final pnpm check passed (0 errors), all 3 ask-user tests passed, and the work was amended into commit 1cf713b.
decisions: Replaced beforeAll with beforeEach that conditionally calls registerWebExtensions when extension('ask-user') is not already registered, so extension UI is shared across tests in the same file via the runtime registry.

Changed the registered-extension assertion from toBe(gizmoWebExtension) to expect(extension('ask-user')?.id).toBe('ask-user') because the registry stores a reactive proxy, not the original object reference.

Resolved the 'selected Blue' assertion via screen.getAllByText('Blue').map(el => el.closest('li')).find(Boolean) instead of getByRole('listitem', { name: '2. Blue' }) because the li has no accessible name.

Used a relative import '../../../../packages/protocol/src/index' (not the workspace alias @gizmo/protocol) in AskUserToolResult.svelte so svelte-check resolves it inside the pi-extensions source tree.
Typed the test fixture's status as 'complete' as const to match the ToolCallView literal-union field type.
errors: ReferenceError: beforeAll is not defined — fixed by replacing with beforeEach.
AssertionError on registered extension comparison — the registry held a reactive proxy, not the original; switched to id comparison.
TestingLibraryElementError: multiple elements matched 'Blue' — fixed by scoping through getAllByText + closest('li').
svelte-check: Cannot find module '@gizmo/protocol' — first attempt at relative path had wrong depth (4 ups, missing 'packages/'); fixed to '../../../../packages/protocol/src/index'.
svelte-check: status 'string' not assignable to 'running'|'complete'|'error' — fixed by typing test fixture status as const.
